title: Friends working on antigravity received threats

tellings.quote: You mentioned on Danny Jones that several of your friends worked on antigravity and received a kind of backlash,

plain: Several friends of a guest named Kevin Knuth, whom the episode's title calls a whistleblower from NASA, the US space agency, are said to have worked on antigravity, meaning ways to cancel or push against gravity, and to have faced backlash for it. Michels raises this himself, reminding Knuth that he had said so on another podcast, the Danny Jones show. If true, it would suggest that research into such ideas is pushed back against.
